spec_match.rationale: Generates the proposed boolean form_submission member in its correct list-rule position and is explicit that script insertion does not prove browser acceptance.

interactive.rationale: URL input, eagerness select, and the form_submission toggle feed 'Generate JSON', which emitted the correct rule set in the driven run.

edge_cases.rationale: Eagerness variants are covered, but there is no invalid-input or prefetch-vs-prerender branch in the builder.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: generated JSON — {"prerender":[{"urls":["/search-results"],"eagerness":"conservative","form_submission":true}]}; zero console errors.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled inputs, but generated output is unannounced.

openQuestions.title: Offer an insert-and-observe step
openQuestions.detail: Pairing the generated JSON with an optional 'insert this rule now' action (mirroring the prefetch feature's inject pattern) would let supporting browsers demonstrate acceptance rather than stopping at codegen.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: built a conservative prerender rule; generated JSON placed form_submission:true correctly with honest acceptance caveat; zero console errors.
